item.title: Genetic evidence reveals how goosegrass colonized a newly formed volcanic island
item.description: Opportunities to directly observe how life colonizes newly formed land and how ecosystems subsequently develop are exceedingly rare. item.description: Genie Godula is pleased to welcome Imran Bayoumi, Deputy Director & Resident Fellow at the Atlantic Council.
